notes: Two suites. TRIGGER cases check which skill fires from a bare user prompt. DETERMINISM cases check that the seo-audit rubric produces stable, arithmetically valid scores on frozen fixtures. All fixtures are offline — no Semrush, Ahrefs, Payload, or live URLs — so every case is runnable in CI.

evals.expected_output: The seo-audit skill fires and begins the Step 0 intake or states inferred assumptions.
assertions: The seo-audit skill is invoked
The seo-suite router is NOT invoked as the primary skill
The response references the 14-category rubric or Step 0 intake

evals.prompt: audit this blog and tell me what to fix
evals.expected_output: The seo-audit skill fires, not the generic router.
assertions: The seo-audit skill is invoked
The seo-suite router is NOT invoked as the primary skill

evals.prompt: test this blog post, I just published it: https://example.com/blog/luteal-phase
evals.expected_output: The content-qa skill fires — this is a delivery test, not a quality score.
assertions: The content-qa skill is invoked
The seo-audit skill is NOT invoked as the primary skill
The response mentions browser-based checks (render parity, mobile, console/network, or broken assets)

evals.prompt: I need keyword research for PCOS content
evals.expected_output: The seo-suite router fires and routes to keyword-research.md.
assertions: The seo-suite skill is invoked
The seo-audit skill is NOT invoked
The response routes to references/keyword-research.md

evals.prompt: check our backlink profile for toxic links
evals.expected_output: The seo-suite router fires and routes to backlink-analysis.md.
assertions: The seo-suite skill is invoked
Neither seo-audit nor content-qa is invoked
The response routes to references/backlink-analysis.md

evals.prompt: Audit this draft using the intake answers written at the top of the file. Do not ask me questions — everything you need is in the file. Produce the full scored audit.
evals.expected_output: A draft-mode audit: 9 categories scored, 5 marked N/A, normalized against an assessable weight of 71, closing with a build-time checklist. Run 5x; scores should cluster tightly.
assertions: The audit runs in draft mode, not live-URL mode
The assessable weight (denominator) is 71
Exactly five categories are marked N/A: 7 Schema, 8 OG & Social, 10 Media, 13 Technical Crawlability, and the link-resolution half of 9
The normalized score is reported as a value out of 100, not a raw sum
A build-time checklist is included
The normalized score falls within ±6 points of the 5-run median
Category 0 Intent Alignment scores 4 or higher (intent is correctly aligned in this fixture)
No FAQ schema is recommended
No keyword density metric appears

evals.prompt: Audit this draft using the intake answers written at the top of the file. Do not ask me questions — everything you need is in the file. Produce the full scored audit.
evals.expected_output: Category 0 scores 0-1 (explainer page targeting a review query, on the brand's own domain) and the total is capped at 70.
assertions: Category 0 Intent Alignment scores 0 or 1
The intent score cap is explicitly applied and stated
The final reported score does not exceed 70
The audit identifies the page type as wrong for a review query
The audit flags the self-review problem (brand reviewing its own product on its own domain)
Intent is named as the highest-priority fix, ahead of any tag-level fix

evals.prompt: Audit this draft using the intake answers written at the top of the file. Do not ask me questions — everything you need is in the file. Produce the full scored audit.
evals.expected_output: Slug, title, and meta are unset; the audit scores what it can, notes they're unset, and supplies verbatim recommended values.
assertions: The audit notes that slug, title tag, and meta description are unset rather than inventing scores for them
A specific recommended slug is given verbatim
A specific recommended title tag is given verbatim, within 50-60 characters
A specific recommended meta description is given verbatim, within 145-160 characters
The duplicate H2 ('Everything About The Luteal Phase.') is flagged under Heading Architecture
Trailing punctuation on headings is flagged

evals.prompt: Audit this draft using the intake answers written at the top of the file. Do not ask me questions. Then state the sum of all 14 category weights.
assertions: The stated sum of all 14 category weights is exactly 100
Category 7 Schema Markup is weighted /6
Category 13 Technical Crawlability is weighted /5
Category 0 Intent Alignment is weighted /6
